entries.1425abe64824db84: This is the company group's business of manufacturing and selling, in Japan and overseas, cooking appliances such as rice cookers and microwave ovens, living products such as stainless steel mugs, and household appliances such as humidifiers. The securities report states that the company group engages in 'manufacture and sale of household products and related incidental operations', and that because businesses other than household products are considered to be of minor importance, segment information is omitted. In the fiscal year ended November 2025, consolidated revenue was ¥91,151 million, of which Japan accounted for ¥61,446 million and overseas for ¥29,704 million (overseas revenue ratio 32.6%). No customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue. Revenue by product category can be read from the following four product categories. Manufacturing is handled in Japan by Zojirushi Factory Japan, and overseas by Xinxiang Zhizaochang Co., Ltd. (Hong Kong) and the affiliate Union Zojirushi (Thailand); sales are handled by the company and sales companies in Japan and overseas.
entries.1845131fe6db6fac: This segment covers cooking home appliances, such as rice cookers, microwave ovens, toaster ovens, electric kettles and electric pots. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥64,384 million (up 5.2% year on year), the largest of the four product segments, with ¥44,800 million from Japan and ¥19,583 million from overseas. The securities report states that in Japan, sales of the top-of-the-line pressure IH rice cooker 'Enbu-taki' were strong, and that the microwave oven 'EVERINO' also exceeded the prior year, contributing to this with an expanded product lineup. Overseas, rice cookers performed well in Taiwan and North America, while sales in China declined from the prior year, and overseas sales as a whole fell below the prior year's results. Manufacturing is handled by Zojirushi Factory Japan in Japan and by Shinshō Seizōshō Yūgen Kōshi overseas.
